tasks.label: build debug (cl)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && if not exist x64\Debug md x64\Debug && cl /nologo /EHsc /W3 /Zi /Fe:x64\Debug\numc.exe /Fo:x64\Debug\ /Fd:x64\Debug\ numc.cpp /link /DEBUG
tasks.detail: Compile numc.cpp with /Zi for debugging into x64\Debug\numc.exe

tasks.label: build release (cl)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && if not exist x64\Release md x64\Release && cl /nologo /EHsc /W3 /O2 /Fe:x64\Release\numc.exe /Fo:x64\Release\ numc.cpp
